newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African wool prices higher at latest auction.
newsitem.headline: S.African wool prices higher at latest auction.

text.p: South African wool prices were higher at the latest weekly auction, the Wool Board said.
It said 10,908 bales were offered at this week's sale, of which 97.7 percent was sold.

Price quotes for long Merino fleeces of 20 micron fell 1.0 percent, 21 micron fell 0.5 percent, 22 micron rose 1.9 percent, 23 micron rose 2.9 percent, 24 micron rose 1.9 percent and 25 micron rose 1.8 percent.
Prices for Merino bellies rose 2.3 percent, Merino lambs rose 0.3 percent and Merino locks fell 2.3 percent.
The offering included 1,668 bales of other White Wools, 175 bales of Ciskei/Transkei, 331 bales of Lesotho and 553 bales of coarse and coloured.

Of the 396 bales of 20 micron offered, 97.0 percent was sold. Of the 1,254 bales of 21 micron offered, 98.5 percent was sold. Of 2,222 bales of 22 micron offered, 97.5 percent was sold, Of 1,214 bales of 23 micron offered, 97.8 percent was sold. Of 545 bales fo 24 micron offered, 97.8 percent was sold. All 25 micron bales on offer were sold.
The next sale will take place on 11 December, when 10,000 bales will be on offer.
